title: Beyond Passing Tests: An Interface-Only Specification Review Cuts Silent Failures of a Local Gemma Coding Agent
description: Independent empirical study of interface-only specification review for a local Gemma coding agent. Revision 2 aligns public repository identity, licensing and reproduction metadata; experimental outcomes are unchanged. Includes post-hoc pooled and shared-specification sensitivity analyses; Campaign A primary task-level hypothesis was not confirmed. Code and evidence: https://github.com/cyberdid/cloud-edge-ai-orchestrator/tree/paper-i-preprint-2026-10-21-rev2
